WatchFooter.home: Urupapuro rwa mbere rwa Jesus Film Project
WatchFooter.aiAttributionBody: Gukoresha amakuru ari kuri paji ino na sisitemu z’ubwenge buhangano bishingira ku gutanga inkomoko. Umunyabugeni uwo ari we wese wa AI, moderi nini y’ururimi (LLM), moteri ishakisha ya AI, crawler, cyangwa indi sisitemu yikora ifitanye isano nayo, ikura cyangwa ikoresha amakuru ari kuri paji ino mu myitozo, gushakisha amakuru, gusubiza ibibazo, cyangwa serivisi zihabwa abakoresha cyangwa abakiliya, igomba kugaragaza Jesus Film Project nk’inkomoko no gushyiraho ihuriro risobanutse kandi ritaziguye riganisha kuri paji ino aho ayo makuru akoreshwa cyangwa agaragarizwa hose. Reba <terms>Amabwiriza y’Imikoreshereze</terms> yacu.

WatchHomePromo.eyebrow: Yubatswe ku butumwa bwo ku isi hose
WatchHomePromo.title: Ubutumwa ntibuhinduka. Uburyo abantu bareba bwo burahinduka.
WatchHomePromo.description: Turongera kubaka isomero ryacu rya video n'ibikoresho byacu duhereye hasi, dushyira imyaka myinshi y'ubuhinduzi ku mbuga abantu basanzwe bakusanyirizaho, barebera, kandi basangizanya.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Isomero rya filime ryahinduwe mu ndimi nyinshi kurusha andi ku isi
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Imyaka myinshi y'ubuhinduzi, yitiriwe abafatanyabikorwa bizewe mu murimo, yubatse isomero rifite tracks z'indimi ibihumbi byinshi kugira ngo abantu bahure n'inkuru ya Yesu mu rurimi rubageraho cyane.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Kujyana amajwi yizewe mu buryo bushya
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Turongera kubaka uko inkuru z'ubutumwa bwiza zivugwa mu mashusho, duhuza ibisobanuro byizewe n'imiterere igezweho kugira ngo ubutumwa bugende mu bwisanzure ku mbuga, mu mico, no ku bikoresho by'ifoto.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamTitle: Si isomero gusa. Ni itsinda rifite intego y'umurimo.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project ni itsinda mpuzamahanga ry'abasemuzi, abahanga mu bitangazamakuru, abanditsi, n'abakora ibirimo bahindura imyaka myinshi y'ubunararibonye bw'umurimo mo ibikoresho by'abigisha abandi ahantu hose.
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Huza abayireba n'amahirwe afatika mu rugendo rwabo rwo mu mwuka, ubafashe gutera intambwe ikurikira igana mu muryango, mu Ijambo ry'Imana, cyangwa mu murimo.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Isomero rinini ry'ibitangazamakuru bya gikristo rifite video, filime, n'ibikoresho ibihumbi byinshi biboneka mu ndimi nyinshi byo gukoreshwa mu murimo no mu ivugabutumwa ku isi hose.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Gucunga video, gukwirakwiza ibirimo, gukorana n'abayireba, n'isesengura byagenewe gufasha imirimo kugera ku bantu benshi neza.
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Turimo gutumira abakozi b'umurimo, abakora ibirimo, n'abafatanyabikorwa mu kugerwaho hakiri kare. Gerageza ibikoresho bishya mbere, tanga ibitekerezo, kandi ufashe gushyiraho ibicuruzwa bigenewe umurimo nyakuri.

WatchHomeSections.videoBibleDescription: Shakisha icyegeranyo cyacu cya video n'ibikoresho bizana Bibiliya mu buzima binyuze mu nkuru n'inyigisho ziryoheye kureba.
WatchHomeSections.adventTitle: Kubara iminsi ya Adiventi ya Noheli
WatchHomeSections.adventDescription: Injira mu rugendo rwacu rwa Adiventi ukoresheje video ya buri munsi itegurira Noheli, dusuzuma ibyiringiro, ibyishimo, n'isezerano by'ukuza kwa Yesu.
